long_biography.plain_text:
IAR-Siltal made Teresio Lupano a significant figure in Italy's white-goods industry. As owner and chairman, he directed the Occimiano-based group as it absorbed Siltal and a succession of appliance factories, extending production across refrigerators, washing machines, dryers and dishwashers. By 2004 it ranked among Italy's largest appliance manufacturers by employment and turnover.

Lupano's industrial career intersected with competitive powerboating. He finished third in the 1976 Pavia-Venice international motorboat raid, a long-running river race. That competitive maritime background provides a distinctive counterpart to the manufacturing career he built around refrigeration and domestic appliances.
